Independent Jeweler Marketing Leads

CaratBase delivers verified local leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers. First 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead, with an optional $29/month valuation widget for your website.

What you get

• First 3 leads free • $40 per accepted lead • $29/month valuation widget

Why CaratBase

Get high‑intent customers looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or buy an engagement ring. Expand your reach in Atlanta and beyond with proven local leads.

FAQ

How do I get started with CaratBase? Sign up on our website, receive your first 3 free leads, and start accepting leads at $40 each.

What is the valuation widget? An optional $29/month add‑on that lets visitors on your site request a free gold valuation.

Next step: Sign up now to receive your first 3 free leads and grow your local customer base.
